additional_read: Complete cli.cmd_work and cmd_check unresolved-log loading/error branch.

tests.scope: Complete work accounting file; temporary graph/log writes, no external backend.

findings: Operational resolution removes an item from unresolved work, never establishes a mathematical claim. Graph bytes remain unchanged in the source test.
Closed record shapes, UTC timestamps, finite nonnegative budget metadata and existing family IDs are checked. New writes require a live family in the supplied graph snapshot.
Work lock serializes writers to that log, not graph changes. A stale caller graph is not refreshed under that lock; no cross-log transaction or concurrent-race proof follows.

Each work log folds independently before unresolved results are combined; resolutions cannot reference an attempt in a different log. This is operational merge behavior, not graph concatenation semantics.
Budget numbers are metadata, not enforced resource limits. A nonblank resolution rationale does not prove retry success.
Missing log is empty; malformed log is surfaced; final-newline repair and duplicate/resolution rejection are covered.
remaining: Disposition operational merge/identity policy separately from mathematical warrant semantics.
Crash and concurrent graph/work behavior remain untested; current controls do not prove cross-file atomicity.
Complete broader check/CLI integration review; work ledger tests are not whole-hook enforcement evidence.
